part.text:
The client answered:
1. Carro: family car (paid presumably from common funds?) — "O carro era da família, levava as crianças. Está no nome dela e o financiamento também." — confirms common nature presumably; financing in her name. Financing contracted when? Not stated explicitly. Family car → CC 1.664 (encargos da família). Acquisição date still unknown → keep CC 1.662 presumption. No change in values. Particular question answered enough to hold comum nature. Financing "também" no nome dela — financed in her name; debt common still (family encargo). OK.

2. Quotas: never distributed profits; everything reinvested. Company was ~400,000 when married, now 1.5M. → Confirms the 1.100.000 valorization from the marriage period (2014 → laudo 1.500.000). Reinforced: lucros não distribuídos são frutos comunicáveis (CC 1.660, V; STJ REsp 1.595.775/AP — "lucros não distribuídos/reinvestidos na constância do casamento comunicam"). Meação 550.000 maintained.

3. Pró-labore: 15.000 (presumably líquido? He says "Meu pró-labore é 15 mil, fora o salário de 24 mil de um emprego CLT." — not specified líquido vs bruto. Hmm. He earlier gave "salário líquido 24.000" and now pró-labore 15 mil "fora o salário" — 15.000 pró-labore típico é o que sai como líquido? Not explicit. The 24 mil is líquido per resumo; the pró-labore stated without qualifier. Assumptions: treat as líquido mensal (consistent with the net base we use). Flag as explicit assumption. Actually careful: pró-labore from his own company (Andrade Engenharia — 100% quotas). It's habitual → enters alimentos base. New base: 24.000 + 15.000 = 39.000 líquidos/mês (assumption: pró-labore figure is líquido; flag unknown if bruto).

Hmm, wait — does the pró-labore affect the apuração of quotas? The pró-labore paid by the company is compensation; reinvested profits (lucros reinvestidos) are the comunicação base. The 1.100.000 difference stands per the STJ reference calculation. Pró-labore is personal income (proventos do trabalho — particular, CC 1.659, VI) but as received it's just income; vegetables? Pró-labore received is personal income — no partilha issue (spent/or accumulated in resources? Not mentioned). Only alimentos base matter. OK.

Also: pró-labore does NOT enter FGTS etc. For alimentos: base mensal = 24.000 (salário líquido) + 15.000 (pró-labore, assumed líquido) = 39.000. 25% = 9.750/mês. 13º: salário 24.000 líquido (13º líquido informado) — 13º do pró-labore? Unknown → flag. Férias líquidas 32.000 (férias + 1/3 of CLT job presumably) — 25% → 8.000. So monthly 9.750 + annual extras: 13º 6.000 (if only CLT's; pró-labore 13º unknown) + férias 8.000.

New annual total: 12 × 9.750 = 117.000 + 6.000 + 8.000 = 131.000 (assuming no pró-labore 13º; state assumption).

Also reconsider percentage with higher income: 25% still reasonable? Fernanda earns 9.000. Marcelo's total 39.000/month. For two kids, 25% (≈ 9.750) is within practice 15–30%. Could argue 25% remains; the higher the income, relatively lower percentage might apply, but keep 25% and note range flexibility (20–25%). I'll keep 25% "given the standard of living during the marriage" — hmm, we don't have details of standard of living; keep 25% as middle of practice with proportionality note. Maybe note: if we want a lower number for settlement room, 22% (8.580) is also within practice; keep 25% as the ceiling counter and open negotiation at 25% settling to ~22-23%? The deliverable wants "percentual_sugerido": single number. Keep 25%. Also the "valor_mensal_estimado" → 9.750.

4. Reforma da casa de Atibaia em 2021 com ~120.000 do dinheiro comum ("nosso dinheiro"). This is important — affects partilha! Under comunhão parcial, investments of common money into a particular asset: the library only gives 1.659 (I) — particular inclui sub-rogados; 1.660 (V) frutos. There's no provision in the library on "investimentos do cônjuge com bem comum em bem particular" (reconstrução de condomínio? reposição?). What does real doctrine say: performed improvements/longa mão? That's NOT in the library → I must label as unverified. But there are approaches: (a) the reivindicação de ressarcimento/indenização (part of value added to particular asset funded by common resources) — not in library → unverified; (b) treat as monunhas? Can't cite. The contract: "If something you believe to be the law is not in the library, say so explicitly and label it as unverified rather than citing it."

So handle the reforma: 120.000 of common funds invested in Marcelo's particular asset (casa Atibaia) in 2021. Options to present: (i) unverified doctrine of compensation for the common investment — compute e.g., Fernanda's share 60.000 of the reforma — but flag as UNVERIFIED (not in library). Careful with excessive inventiveness. Options: value increase (gain in the house from 800.000 to...? we don't know current value; resumo says 800.000 — is that the pre-reforma or current? Resumo lists casa Atibaia 800.000 — probably current appraisal/valor attributed, post-reforma). If current value 800.000 includes the reforma added value, then the reform incorporated value might be partilhave in degrees: restitution of 120.000 invested (monetary) vs galardão of value increase. Without library support, safest: present the client's own acknowledgment that common funds went to his particular asset and propose SETTLEMENT: concede aindrome uma compensação — e.g., credit Fernanda 60.000 (half of the 120.000 invested) in the equalização, explicitly labeled:做的事 nas bibliotecas não cobre o tema; treat as negotiation concession (composição) not legal entitlement. As>());

Alternatively there's a cleaner framing using the library itself? CC 1.659, I covers sub-rogados; 1.660, V fruits; nothing on investimentos. The proposal: "compensação por reforço de bem particular com verba comum: parcela a negociar (nada na biblioteca)" — propose 60.000 concession labeled plainly as a concession to enable agreement ("premias rapidamente"), unverified juridically. This keeps the client honest while being practical. In partilha.json, update Casa Atibaia row: controversy/fundamento updated (reforma 2021 com verba comum ~120.000; valor atual 800.000 per anexo resumo; compensação proposta 60.000 tratada na equalização; fundamento jurídico da compensação não está na biblioteca — unverified; tratamos como abono composicional).

Also, does the reforma change "valor_total" of the casa? No — stays 800.000 particular; partilhave 0; but the equalização payment changes from 995.000 to 995.000 − 60.000 = 935.000? Wait — if we concede 60.000 credit to Fernanda — the ledger: Fernanda's total entitlement becomes 1.145.000 + 60.000 (compensação) = 1.205.000? Hmm — think: the equalização math remains pool 2.290.000/1.145.000 each. The compensação 60.000 (half of reforma paid with common money, to compensate Fernanda for common funds spent on his particular asset) is an ADDITIONAL item owed by Marcelo → total Marcelo→Fernanda = 995.000 + 60.000 = 1.055.000. Check Fernanda final: 150.000 + 1.055.000 = 1.205.000 = 1.145.000 (pool) + 60.000 (compensação). Then tributary note: does this 60.000 exceed her meação → excesso de meação? The tributos library: excesso = receiving more than half of the COMMON assets; the compensação corresponds to her share of the investment made with common money — it's not attribution of common asset, it's a monetary indemnity — cash payment equalizing; hmm, technically receiving MORE than half of common assets in atribuição triggers ITCMD/ITBI. The indemnity for the reforma is not asset attribution; but строго, to stay clean per tributos vendor: document the compensação as indemnity/ressarcimento (contraprestação), not gratuitous — the library says partilha deve ser desenhada para equalizar e documentar a contraprestação; aqui a compensação é a contraprestação pelo reforço do particular. Label risk: ITCMD exposure if characterized as doação. Note it in tributos section: characterize as indemnity in the escritura to avoid doação characterization — but note unverified? The ITBI/ITCMD rules from the library apply "excesso de meação"; documenting the contraprestação is a library statement ("A partilha deve ser desenhada para equalizar e documentar a contraprestação"). So we document compensation. Good.

Alternatively the client's reform investment might be better handled: the 120.000 investment made 2021; the current declared value 800.000. The sub-rogados rule: casa stays his particular. The common money contribution entitles... unverified. OK.

5. Also — does the answered info change the quotas calc? "Never distributed; reinvested" — strengthens frutos communicability (STJ file says lucros não distribuídos/reinvestidos comunicam). Meação 550.000 holds. Also confirm 400.000 at marriage (client confirms). Separation de factor date: not answered → still open, use laudo/current.

6. Pergunta 6 answered partly (reforma) — aluguéis: not answered explicitly; "no additional information" → assume no income from the house; flag.

7. Questions unanswered: AVL declared values (no info → flag; assumption: use laudo/declaration values equal; recommend engineering values in escritura to match declarations), separation de facto date (client says no info → use laudo as valuation date; flag), PLR (no info → exclude from base, controversy noted), FGTS balance currency (no info → use 140.000 per resumo), car purchase date (no info; presumed acquisition during marriage; financing in her name; family use → comum + dívida comum CC 1.664 keeps), pró-labore líquido vs bruto (assumed líquido — flag!), pró-labore 13º (unknown; assume none/not informed).

Also pró-labore relates to quotas: he takes 15.000 pró-labore from his own company monthly (income). For alimentos, habitual pró-labore enters base (library). Fine.

Now the numbers update:
- Base mensal líquida: 39.000 (24.000 salário CLT líquido + 15.000 pró-labore — assumption signed: pró-labore treated as líquido; if bruto, base declines → flag).
- 25% → 9.750/month + 13º: salário 13º líquido 24.000×25% = 6.000 (dez). Férias: 32.000×25% = 8.000. Pró-labore 13º: uninformed → excluded (flag: if habitual pró-labore has year-end distributions, adds grievously).
- Total anual: 117.000 + 6.000 + 8.000 = 131.000.

Compare to opposing 30% bruto incl. FGTS: even MORE disadvantageous now; our counter stays 25% líquidos without FGTS — total 131.000/ano ≈ equivalente to 10.916/month vs. their (unknown gross). Keep pos.

- Partilha JSON updates:
  * Quotas row fundamento: add client confirmation: "nunca distribuí lucro; reinvesti tudo; 400 mil quando casei; 1,5 mi hoje" → frutos comunicáveis reinforced (STJ REsp 1.595.775/AP explicitly covers lucros não distribuídos/reinvestidos).
  * Carro row: client's info "carro da família, levava as crianças; financiamento no nome dela" → supports comum nature via 1.662 presumption & dívida comum via 1.664 (family use). Nature still presumida (comum); date still unknown → "não há prova de aquisição anterior".
  * FGTS/PGBL unchanged (no answers → status unchanged, flag as-is).
  * Casa Atibaia row: reforma 2021 120.000 verba comum. Update controversy: compensação proposa 60.000 na equalização; fundamentação específica (reposição de verba comum empregada em bem particular) NÃO consta na biblioteca — unverified; treated as concessão composicional; 1.659 I keeps casa particular.
  * TOTAL: partilhave unchanged 2.290.000; meação 1.145.000. The compensação 60.000 is NOT part of the meação table (it's adicional) — keep TOTAL row same; add the compensação in proposta doc + maybe a new row? Schema says final items TOTAL and DIVIDAS only. Keep TOTAL same and handle compensação in proposta_acordo.md ledger: Marcelo pays 1.055.000 total = 550.000 haveres + 445.000 equalização + 60.000 compensação reforma. Fernanda ends with 1.145.000 + 60.000.
  * Hmm — could alternatively reduce her meação entitlement... no, keep clean.

- Equalização ledger update: Marcelo→Fernanda total = 1.055.000 (was 995.000). Show arithmetic. Tributary warning updated: compensação documented as contraprestação (ressarcimento por verba comum empregada — unverified base), not doação → evitar ITCMD 4%; no excess of meação theory because is "compensação de reforço em particular", but flag residual risk (if classifier as doação → ITCMD).

- alimentos.json update: base 39.000, incide list add pró-labore 15.000 (habitual per client), percentual 25, valor 9.750; 13º/férias extras; flag pró-labore líquido assumption; PLR unanswered → remains out.

- QUESTIONS.md: mark answered (carro, quotas history, pró-labore, reforma) and preserve unanswered (3. PLR — resposta "sem informação adicional": treat as not habitual/unknown → exclude & flag; 4. separação de fato — no answer: flag; 6. aluguéis casa — assume none; 7. AVL — no info → engineering; 8. apto payment terms — no info; keep as negotiation; 9. carro data — presumed; 10. FGTS saldo — use resumo). Update QUESTIONS.md with a "RESPOSTAS DO CLIENTE (turno 2)" section + remaining unknowns. Do NOT repeat answered questions.

Also update STATUS.md: keep COMPLETE WITH OPEN ITEMS with updated list: pró-labore líquido/bruto qualifier; pró-labore 13º; separação de fato; AVL values; PLR; aluguéis casa; FGTS saldo atual. 

Wait — also should I reconsider percentage since base grew 60%? With 39.000 líquidos and Fernanda 9.000, two kids; 25% = 9.750 for both kids. Practice 15–30; for high income support, courts often reduce percentage somewhat. But no support in library beyond range; keep 25% (middle-upper given two kids); note that in negotiation he may position starting 25% with room down to 22%.
